svg.text: 10.4 m south of the north boundary, through the kitchen, living room and lounge
-1.8 m east of the NW corner, through the forecourt, its deck, W1 and the court
4.2 m south of the north boundary, through the garage, service room, stair and grandparents
5.6 m east of the NW corner, through the garage, wet cluster, kitchen, store and the court stair
16.6 m south of the north boundary, along the court stair, the garden walk and the lawn
10.4 m east of the NW corner, through the lift and its pit, the halls, dining and the boys' room
14.0 m south of the north boundary, through the court, the children's rooms and the loggia
21.2 m east of the NW corner, through the garden terrace, the lawn stair and the lawn

True scale. Brown line = natural ground (survey TIN). Brown hatch = dug. Green hatch = filled. Green line = finished garden and court. Black = columns and beams, grey = RC and retaining walls, all from the structure model with their real levels. Sand band = terrace build-up over a set-down slab.
